subject: Authorization request: reallocate Q3 runtime tranche to infra/platform roles
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jun 2028 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Authorization request: reallocate Q3 runtime tranche to infra/platform roles

Team —

Quick ask: we have 5 remaining hires in the Q3 runtime tranche pool that were originally earmarked for general runtime SWE roles. After reviewing backlog and platform gaps, Platform/Infra has an immediate need for three mid/senior runtime engineers (runtime infra, kv-cache expertise, batching/kernel optimization) that will materially reduce cost-per-token and unlock two product SLAs for a mid-market customer.

Proposal: reallocate 3 of the 5 open slots from the runtime tranche to Infra/Platform (tagged as RLW-Q3-INFRA). The attached tranche_impact_model.xlsx contains a simple ROI model (est. infra savings, SLA revenue retention, hiring timeline). High level: expected 8-12% unit-cost reduction within 3 months and improved throughput for two flagged clients.

Requesting:
- Executive sign-off to retag 3 slots from runtime to infra (decision by EOD 30 June to keep hiring cadence)
- Permission to use the reserved infra ops budget pool for any comp delta up to $15k per offer
- Confirmation if we need an alternate approver for comp exceptions > $15k

If we get the greenlight, I’ll ask Greenstone to pack offers and coordinate with Legal on template changes.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Talent Strategy (on behalf of Platform Recruiting)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: tranche_impact_model.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48kb)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jun 2028 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorization request: reallocate Q3 runtime tranche to infra/platform roles

Lauren —

Thanks for the write-up and model. A couple of clarifying questions before I can sign off:
1) Comp bands: can you confirm which comp bands the three roles will be hired into (L4/L5/L6?). Need to ensure we don’t create a pay compression issue with current on‑bench staff. I’ve attached a quick comp_bands_summary.pdf that shows current mid-Q3 bands for Platform/Runtime.
2) Offer authority: you mention $15k buffer from infra ops pool — do we have CFO approval to use that pool for these repurposed slots or is this a manager-level delegation?
3) Timeline: if we approve now, what’s the expected OTE delivery date (start dates)? I want to confirm it won’t fall into the Q4 headcount freeze window.

Please reply with those details and I’ll escalate to Irene for exec sign-off.

—Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Platform Engineering

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 29 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorization request: reallocate Q3 runtime tranche to infra/platform roles

I reviewed Markus’s notes and the model. I’m comfortable with reallocation with the following conditions:

- Approve 2 of the 3 roles immediately (L5 runtime infra; L4 runtime infra) to be filled from the tranche.
- The 3rd role (senior L6) is approved contingent on (a) candidate pipeline reaching at least two finalists and (b) comp delta refused by current bench promotions not exceeding $20k.
- All hires must be tagged in Workday with budget code RLW-Q3-INFRA and noted in the weekly headcount report.
- Any comp exception > $20k requires Finance + Irene approval.

If Lauren can confirm comp band targets and provide candidate shortlist by Monday, we should be able to proceed.

Kimberly Park
Head of People Operations

Greenstone / Legal —

Forwarding internal authorization thread. Short summary: Kimberly has pre-approved two slots (L4, L5) and a conditional approval for the L6 pending two finalists and comp delta confirmation. Please prepare offer packages for the two approved roles using the attached offer_template_runtime.docx and hold the L6 package in draft until I send the shortlist.

Please ensure:
- Use banded comp ranges per comp_bands_summary.pdf (attached in thread).
- Include standard equity refresh language for mid-level platform hires.
- Send drafts to LegalOps (CC’d) before extension.

ETA: if Legal and Greenstone can produce drafts by Monday EOD, Talent can extend offers by Tue 2 July.

Thanks —
Lauren
Director, Talent Strategy
